verdict.rationale: Adyen's POS docs cover Terminal API integration, PCI PTS certified terminals (chip/contactless), Tap to Pay on iPhone for contactless/mobile-wallet acceptance, offline payment continuity, and unified transaction management, all directly supporting in-person chip/contactless/mobile-wallet acceptance. Missing for 10: explicit mention of Google Pay support and independent hands-on confirmation of wallet acceptance beyond Apple Pay (the HN complaint concerns integration complexity/pricing, not payment-method failure).
